description: 3i Infotech Limited provides information technology services and solutions in India and internationally. It operates through the Application, Automation, Analytics (AAA); Infrastructure services (IS); Business process services (BPS); and Other segments. The company offers integrated solutions for application development and maintenance, process automation, and data-driven insights; human capital management and digital HR outsourcing services; application development, modernisation and support services; and data operations/transformation services. It also provides hybrid IT managed and multi vendor services; backoffice automation, CX and digital sales, voice and non-voice, and registrar and transfer agent services; CSP and Managed, cloud observability and optimisation, and SASE services; digital first testing and automation, AI-powered use cases, gen AI, and agentic AI services; and digital BPO, and back office operations and automation services. In addition, the company offers application and quality engineering, data and analytics, intelligent automation, and ERP practices; digital workplace, hybrid cloud infrastructure, tools, automation, and AIOps, and cybersecurity services; and AI-led contact centre, intelligent operations, and investor services and solutions. Further, it provides infrastructure services, including digital infrastructure management services, hybrid IT, tools-as-aservice, and cybersecurity-as-a-service; and digital-first testing, BI and reporting, and DataOps. Additionally, the company offers application services comprising testing; automation services; NuRe Campus, an enterprise resource planning solution designed for higher education institutions; and enterprise governance risk and compliance solution. It serves insurance; banking and financial services; healthcare; education; manufacturing; telecom, media and entertainment; and government industries. 3i Infotech Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.
